people.name: Pilate
people.line: Roman governor who presided over Jesus' trial

translations.web: Pilate again asked them, “What then should I do to him whom you call the King of the Jews?”
translations.bsb: So Pilate asked them again, “What then do you want me to do with the One you call the King of the Jews?”
translations.kjv: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?
translations.asv: And Pilate again answered and said unto them, What then shall I do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?
